title: Colored smiley emblem
caption: A fictional adult with a small golden smiley motif colored into the close-cropped hair at the back-right of the head. This generated guide image is illustrative and does not depict Dennis Rodman.
patternDescription: Short, tightly textured dark hair carries a small, high-contrast yellow smiley design. The motif follows the hair rather than appearing as ink on the scalp.
lengthDescription: The hair is clipped very short and evenly, leaving enough visible hair for the color to follow its texture.
